title: The Power of Dreams! Proof of Strength!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next morning, I arrived at the academy grounds earlier than usual once again. This time it wasn't by coincidence, but with a clear purpose.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hmm, maybe I shouldn't run on the turf today... But I still wanna train just a little bit more.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer?! What's up? Did you wake up super early again?
choice_data_list: Will you let me help you take care of your hooves?
Will you let me help you take care of your hooves?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh?! A-Are you sure?! But we barely just met the other day!!
choice_data_list: I'll make sure you can compete on turf.
I'll make sure you can compete on turf.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Compete on turf—
Like, enough to properly go toe-to-toe with Oguri-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I give a firm nod. I intended to do everything necessary to ensure her conditioning was flawless.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...! In that case, I gotta give it everything I've got too!! Wait, that means I'm allowed to go all out, right?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you, Trainer!! I swear... I'm gonna win this!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After school, Bamboo Memory and I sat down for a strategy meeting.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So basically, we're gonna train while keeping a close eye on my hooves, right?
choice_data_list: Right. It might feel frustrating at times, but...
Right. It might feel frustrating at times, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The reason Bamboo Memory focused primarily on dirt was because dirt courses produce less speed, reducing the impact on her legs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Conversely, turf is smoother and makes it easier to build speed, but that momentum carries a significantly harsher impact.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That meant we couldn't jump straight into high-load training. We needed to proceed gradually, prioritizing hoof care above all else.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Understood!! To be totally honest, I really wanna go wild and train like crazy, but...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Strengthening my hooves is part of the training too!! I promise I'll do exactly what you say!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Another day――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer!
What's with all these fancy-looking cosmetics!?
choice_data_list: They're nail oil and top coat!
They're nail oil and top coat!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nail... Ah, I know this stuff!
You paint it on your nails, right!? Is this part of training too!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apply oil to moisturize, and a top coat to protect the nail. Nail care
is a perfectly valid form of conditioning!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right, got it! Ah, but I've never really
dabbled in this kind of stuff before, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So please! Teach me how to do proper nail care!
'Cause I wanna be able to do it myself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet another day――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Fire up, Hot-Blooded Training!! Number twenty!!
Explosive Heat Acceleration! Peregrine Falcon Switchback Drills!! ――Complete!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this new "Hot-Blooded Training"
routine you put together feels amazing!
choice_data_list: That's because the original routine was already great.
That's because the original routine was already great.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It still totally feels like Dad's workouts!!
Gets me fired right up!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, though... I kinda feel like
running just a little bit more~...
choice_data_list: Patience is part of training too.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir!!
――Hehe. Dad used to say something like that too.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You're totally right, self-control is hot-blooded training too!!
Alright, time to endure with all my fiery might~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On another day―― Bamboo Memory stood watching
the other horsegirls giving their all in training.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah. Honestly, I'm getting antsy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But we made a promise, right? That you'd get me ready to fight on turf.
And if my Trainer says so――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All I gotta do is believe. And once I believe in something, I never back down!
Dad taught me that too!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why're you thanking me, Trainer!?
I'm the one who should be thanking you, always!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I almost forgot! That nail oil you gave me is
running out! Where do you buy that stuff?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...To be frank, I had considered the possibility she might quit halfway through.
Keeping up with steady, unglamorous conditioning is surprisingly hard.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I see, so they sell it at drugstores! I'll buy the second
bottle myself—I've gotten pretty used to taking care of 'em now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And yet, Bamboo Memory placed complete trust in someone she had only
just met. It was a testament to her honest nature――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And an undeniable reminder of just how
unshakeable her devotion to her dream really was.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few more days passed―― right around the time
Bamboo Memory opened her second bottle of nail oil.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hah... hah... hah... hah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her footing was light. Compared to when she first started
training on turf, her times had improved dramatically.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, meticulous aftercare would still be necessary.
Her hoof concerns hadn't completely vanished, but――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (I'm good, I can do this. With this――)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I can fight Oguri-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The continuous care and rigorous training had borne fruit.
Looking at her peak condition, one couldn't help but feel her boundless potential...!
